school.name: Information Technology High School
school.overview: Information Technology High School (ITHS) is a state-of-the-art high school dedicated to preparing students to meet the demands of the 21st century. Technology is our chief focus and is offered as a specialty area of learning. Our goal is to ensure that all of our graduates will be career, civic and college ready with the skills necessary to succeed in tomorrow's world of work and to be true global citizens.
school.subway: 7, E, G, M to 23rd St-Ely Av; N, Q to Queensboro Plaza; R to Queens Plaza
